body.name: \(\widehat\eta_{n,k}^{(-f)}(O)\)
body.def: For learners \(\widehat\pi_{n,k}^{(-f)},\widehat e_{n,k}^{(-f)},\widehat m_{n,k,a}^{(-f)}\) trained outside fold \(f\), \(\widehat\eta_{n,k}^{(-f)}(O)=\frac{\widehat\pi_{n,k}^{(-f)}(X)}{q_{n,k}}[\frac{RA\{Y-\widehat m_{n,k,1}^{(-f)}(X)\}}{\widehat e_{n,k}^{(-f)}(X)}-\frac{(1-A)\{Y-\widehat m_{n,k,0}^{(-f)}(X)\}}{1-\widehat e_{n,k}^{(-f)}(X)}]+\frac{R}{q_{n,k}}\{\widehat m_{n,k,1}^{(-f)}(X)-\widehat m_{n,k,0}^{(-f)}(X)\}\).
